articleTitle: Why Getting Out of Bed When You Can't Sleep Actually Works
imageHeadline: Can't Sleep? Get Out of Bed—Here's Why It Works
imageSubtext: The full science behind the technique is on the site
pinTitle: why you should get out of bed when you can't sleep at night
pinDescription: Lying awake and can't fall asleep? Getting out of bed is a core CBT-I technique called stimulus control that helps retrain your brain to link bed with sleep, not frustration or wakefulness. Learn exactly how to use this evidence-based sleep strategy and when to get back into bed.
